tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and the centre work area frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts, table body, form inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Side panes (project list, file tree), table header, tab strip.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, quiet buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tree row, active project, selected table row.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; tooltip ground.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panes and table rows. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkbox). 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, pane headings on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled-looking hints on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Meets 4.5:1; never use for essential content.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Verdigris. Selected-item indicator, active tab edge, checked boxes, progress. Sparingly.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-filled controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: selected tab underline area, info notices.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on all surfaces and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. 3:1 on every surface token AND on terminal-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: status-provisioning
tokens.usage: Workspace is being created for the first time. Transitional: shown with motion. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-provisioning-soft.

tokens.name: status-provisioning-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for provisioning. Carries status-provisioning text.

tokens.name: status-starting
tokens.usage: Workspace is booting, or desired state is running while state is stopped. Transitional: shown with motion. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-starting-soft.

tokens.name: status-starting-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for starting. Carries status-starting text.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Workspace is up and connectable. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-running-soft.

tokens.name: status-running-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for running. Carries status-running text.

tokens.name: status-stopping
tokens.usage: Workspace is shutting down, or desired state is stopped while state is running. Transitional: shown with motion. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-stopping-soft.

tokens.name: status-stopping-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for stopping. Carries status-stopping text.

tokens.name: status-stopped
tokens.usage: Workspace is off. Neutral, never alarming. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-stopped-soft.

tokens.name: status-stopped-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for stopped. Carries status-stopped text.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Workspace failed to reach its desired state. Always paired with a user-language sentence and actions. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-error-soft.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for error. Carries status-error text.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Approaching a limit (storage near 80 percent, disconnect countdown). Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-warning-soft.

tokens.name: status-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for warning. Carries status-warning text.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and their confirmations. Same hue as error, separate token so the two can diverge. Text, icon and dot colour; 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and status-danger-soft.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and notice fill for danger. Carries status-danger text.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for destructive buttons.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: mark-code
tokens.usage: The code lines inside the NameMark's terminal, on terminal-bg (4.6:1). Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: xterm.js background. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-fg
tokens.usage: xterm.js foreground on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Ended-session and banner text inside the terminal pane, on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-cursor
tokens.usage: xterm.js cursor.

tokens.name: terminal-selection
tokens.usage: xterm.js selection background.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.black. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightBlack. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.red. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightRed. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.green. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightGreen. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.yellow. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightYellow. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.blue. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightBlue. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.magenta. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightMagenta. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.cyan. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightCyan. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.white. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-white
tokens.usage: xterm.js theme.brightWhite. Same in both themes.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: One per page, only on standalone pages (sign-in, session ended, not authorized).

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside panels and empty states.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Your workspace is starting. This usually takes a few seconds.
styles.usage: Default UI and prose text at comfortable density.

styles.name: text-compact
styles.usage: Default text at compact density (administrator tables), tree rows, tab labels.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, pane headings.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Badges, shortcut hints, helper text. Never below 12px.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Paths, ports, commands and values inside the UI (M src/app.ts, 3000 node).

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Image versions, error codes, IDs in administrator views.

spacing.note: 4px base. Names match Tailwind's default spacing steps (p-3 = space-3 = 12px) when --spacing is 4px.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-dot gaps, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls; tree indent unit is space-4.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact control horizontal padding; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Comfortable control horizontal padding; pane header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and dialog inner padding at compact density; tree indent per level.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane gutters at comfortable density.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Standalone page inner padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top offset of standalone pages (sign-in).

radius.note: Mostly square. Real tools (terminal, editor, panes) take radius-none.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panes, terminals, the editor. Real tools keep square corners.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inset elements, shortcut keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, menu items, tooltips. Tabs stay square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the sign-in panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the transition spinner and the pane grip only.

shadow.note: Used only for things that float above the layout. Dark theme adds a hairline because shadows vanish on dark grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Panes and tables: separated by line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Dragged tab, pressed-free raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, toasts, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, inputs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Comfortable buttons, inputs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Sign-in primary action; the only large control.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and compact rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state and dialog status icons.

tokens.name: size-pane-handle
tokens.usage: Hit area of a resizable pane handle; the visible line is 1px.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed side-pane rail at 1024 wide.

density.note: Two density modes set on a container with data-density. Components read --pk-control, --pk-row, --pk-tab, --pk-pad and --pk-font, which bundle.css maps from these tokens.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-control
tokens.usage: Student default: control height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-row
tokens.usage: Student default: tree, list and menu row height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-tab
tokens.usage: Student default: tab height.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-pad
tokens.usage: Student default: control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: density-comfortable-font
tokens.usage: Student default: UI text size (text-body).

tokens.name: density-compact-control
tokens.usage: Administrator default: control height.

tokens.name: density-compact-row
tokens.usage: Administrator default: table and menu row height.

tokens.name: density-compact-tab
tokens.usage: Administrator default: tab height.

tokens.name: density-compact-pad
tokens.usage: Administrator default: control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: density-compact-font
tokens.usage: Administrator default: UI text size (text-compact).

ring.note: Focus rings: outline in the focus colour, never removed without a replacement.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: ring-offset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset for free-standing controls.

tokens.name: ring-offset-inset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset for rows, tabs and cells inside scrolling containers, so the ring is never clipped.

timing.note: Motion is functional only. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms and the spin becomes a static glyph.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and toasts entering.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One rotation of the transition indicator in StateBadge.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for entering elements.

tokens.name: z-pane-handle
tokens.usage: Resizable pane handles above pane content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and tab strips.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast viewport, above dialogs.
